interpretations.nonblocking: The all-exit diagnostic, post-dispatch receipt bookkeeping and cleanup never change the endpoint, eligibility or grading and never stop the pair. The PRE-dispatch receipt stays blocking (no dispatch without a durable receipt) per the lead's REQ-005 decision (answer 1); the disk reserve for it is checked at admission.
interpretations.probe_cap: Time expiry preserves and publishes incomplete work with its reason; no extra time, outcome-driven stopping or substitution.
interpretations.gate: The gate verifies the environment and the harness only. It sends no model request and is not evidence about model competence.

inherited_labels: Receipts from the reused request_receipt/cue_transport say request DTR-REQ-005 and cohort cue-v1.
episode.json from the reused cue_episode.run_episode has kind 'cue-v1 fixed-order DEV episode (DTR-REQ-005)' and cohort 'cue-v1'.
Private raw request bodies are stored under work/req005_request_receipts/cue-v1/<run_id>.
The baseline arm writes a silent cue_delivery.json / calls.jsonl landmark; no cue is ever appended.

The reused req011_pair components write 'request': 'DTR-REQ-011' in ledger.jsonl lines, in the control entry.json and grade_control.json, in the grader's grade_result.json and in the watchdog records. make_episode_runner names the run directory '<instance>__small__req011__<utc>-<hex>'. These are labels of reused, unedited REQ-011 code.

effective_config.json and episode.json say configuration_binding 'yaml-v1' (pilot_episode.CONFIGURATION_BINDING) and name the cue-v1 driver. Their content is the repair1 configuration, which repair_record.json and this manifest name yaml-v1-repair1.
The probe summary file is named pair_summary.json because req011_pair.publish publishes that name.
This manifest, gate.json, admission.json, repair_record.json, the ledger's order and state fields, and pair_summary.json are authoritative.
semantics_differences: episode.json physical_requests = len(capture.sends) (one send per query attempt at the HTTP layer); the frozen pilot_episode driver used len(attempts).
Token counts come from server-reported usage in the public outcome receipts; unknown usage stays null (the frozen driver used litellm's parsed usage).
submission.diff is written write-once before the all-exit diagnostic and cleanup (same bytes as the frozen driver, which wrote it after cleanup).
exit_status RepeatedFailureStall is new. It is the guard's exit, recorded by the frozen DefaultAgent.run like any InterruptAgentFlow exit (submission '').

The agent container has no network. Commands that need the network fail where the REQ-011 container could reach PyPI; an offline `pip install --upgrade astropy` finds no index candidate and keeps the installed editable astropy (it may exit 0).

The stall guard's output fingerprint masks object addresses (0x...) and decimal-second durations before hashing (repair1.stall_rule), so an identical failing command whose output differs only in those tokens, such as offline pip retry warnings, counts as the same failure.
scope: One single-model DEVELOPMENT repair probe on one already exposed, evaluator-qualified issue: a mechanism check of yaml-v1-repair1 only. It is not a success rate, not a model or routing comparison, not a policy value and not CONFIRM evidence.
